One of the most disappointing pest control services I’ve come across. The staff seemed untrained and rushed through the entire process in barely 10–15 minutes, despite charging ₹800. The work felt incomplete, as I found cockroaches the very next day — it looked like they didn’t spray properly across all areas.

The chemical used had almost no odor, which raises concerns about its effectiveness or dilution. Even after treatment, spiders were still visible, making it clear that the job wasn’t effective.

Overall, poor value for money and not recommended. I’ve had much better pest control experiences before at lower prices. Also, some reviews online seem overly positive, so I’d advise checking carefully before booking.

featured_reviews.name: Deepti Tandon
featured_reviews.review_text: I had opted for a single service, but highly disappointed, cockroaches appeared within 1week of service, we waited for it to lessen or vanish for more time but nothing worked, when complained about it, got extremely rude response, with zero accountability for their service, they didn't even bother to check again once, they drew back any responsibility, just took our money, selling their yearly service and grabbing more cash seems like their main agenda, they then blamed it on our "fate" that it didn't work out for us, extremely rude staff, would not recommend to anyone ever again.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for sharing your feedback. However, we would like to present the facts regarding this service to ensure other customers have a clear and fair understanding of our policies:
* Transparency of Terms: At the time of booking, we explicitly informed the customer via message that they had opted for a 'One-Time Service.' Our policy clearly states that this plan includes only a single treatment and does not include free follow-up visits or complaint attendance.
* Timeline of Complaint: Our records show that the service was performed over a month ago. In professional pest control, if there is a technical flaw in the treatment, it becomes evident within the first week. Raising a concern after 30 days is technically inconsistent with the nature of the service provided.
* Expectation vs. Service Plan: The customer expected multiple follow-up visits under a single-service payment. We always recommend our 'Annual Plan' for severe or long-term infestations, as a single treatment cannot guarantee 100% eradication in high-infestation cases.
* Professional Integrity: We take pride in our service quality at Care Fast India. However, we cannot provide additional free services that fall outside the agreed-upon contract. This negative review appears to be a result of our inability to fulfill demands for free services beyond the chosen plan.
We remain committed to providing honest and effective pest control solutions based on the specific plans chosen by our clients.

Regards,
Management, Care Fast India Pest Control Services
